summary: Temporary approval: restricted telemetry snapshot for customer billing investigation
description:
Issue summary: Engineering has identified a potential invoice discrepancy for Acme Corp (enterprise) tied to unusually high token consumption on 2026-03-05. Finance has asked Support to produce a restricted telemetry snapshot for a bounded timeframe to reconcile usage with billing.

Background: On 2026-03-06 Finance flagged a ~22% variance between usage reported in billing exports and per-token counters we show in the metrics pipeline. Preliminary checks indicate the divergence is limited to a small set of sessions in prod-us-west and correlates with a single model variant. Customer is on an enterprise contract; Finance requests a defensible, auditable export of session-level telemetry.

Impact: High — Finance cannot finalize the customer's invoice without this data. Customer-facing exposure is minimal but data contains session-level prompt/response hashes and anonymized tokens counts. Raw token text must not be exported.

Request: Temporary, least-privilege export of anonymized telemetry for customer Acme Corp covering 2026-03-05 00:00:00 to 2026-03-05 23:59:59 UTC. Scope should include: session_id, timestamp, model_variant, token_count, generation_status, cost_estimate, and a one-way hash of the session prompt (SHA256 with salt managed by Security). Explicitly exclude any raw input/output text or key material.

Data minimization & controls: Export must be run by Support engineer with Security present; output saved to a restricted S3 bucket with customer-acct-only ARN and server-side encryption (KMS). Generated CSV must have no free-text fields. Access to bucket will be time-limited (24 hours) and logged. We request Security to provision a short-lived presigned URL for Finance reviewers only.

Approvers requested: Security (Anika Shah), Privacy/Data Protection (Ethan Bloom), SRE lead (Jin Park).

Desired timeline: snapshot created and delivered to Finance within 48 hours of approval.
steps_to_produce_snapshot:
1) Run analytics query job 'billing_reconcile_v2' with filters: customer_acct = 'acme-corp' AND timestamp between '2026-03-05T00:00:00Z' and '2026-03-05T23:59:59Z'.
2) Ensure job uses 'no_text_export' flag to skip raw text columns.
3) Apply one-way SHA256(salt + session_id) transform on prompt_id field per Security runbook.
4) Save output to s3://redwood-restricted-exports/acme-billing-20260305/<requester>-<ts>.csv with SSE-KMS.
5) Trigger KMS audit and notify approvers in #security and #finance-support channels.
investigation_notes:
- 2026-03-06 09:40: Support triage: billing export and metrics counters diverge on aggregation boundary.
- Initial sampling shows 412 sessions for Acme Corp that account for the delta.
- No 5xx/errors in serving runtime; suspect double-counting in batch-aggregation step for the 'redwood-instruct-6b' variant between 03:00-04:30 UTC.
- Need raw session-level counts (without full text) to reconcile aggregation logic.
- Risk: previous ad-hoc exports lacked proper redaction. This request enforces non-text export and salted hashes.
